We need to apply the template from previous step to the given molecule. Input: from make_1_lvl2-template_search-1 we have mapped_rxn and template_id 1209837. The task: "return all possible precursors of applying the template as the result of the task make_1_lvl2-template_search-1 to the molecule below". So we need to apply template_id 1209837 to the initial_molecule SMILES: "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]". Use apply_template tool.

Let's call apply_template with molecule_smiles and template_id.
